item.title: Nvidia's answer to custom silicon is the half of the market that will never build any
item.summary: The sharpest question on Nvidia's second-quarter call came a Bank of America analyst, who noted that OpenAI and Anthropic - both major beneficiaries of Nvidia's ecosystem investment - are designing their own chips, and that OpenAI had, days earlier, claimed its Jalapeno part outperforms Blackwell.
